mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_PERSON_TAG (ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, STATUS, RULE_ID, BATCH_NO, MATCHED_KEYWORD, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{personId}, #{tagId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{ruleId}, #{batchNo}, #{matchedKeyword}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE AS SOURCE, STATUS, RULE_ID, BATCH_NO, MATCHED_KEYWORD, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'MANUAL'
DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'REMOTE'
